claude-code.notes: Skills live as directories (Claude Code reads frontmatter from SKILL.md). Agents are flat files at .claude/agents/<name>.md with frontmatter — we extract the inner agent.md. Hook scripts are stored under .claude/hooks/<name>.sh AND registered in .claude/settings.json under the hooks.<Event> block (keyed off the hook's frontmatter event:) so the tool actually runs them; without that entry the script never fires. Rules land at .claude/rules/<name>.md — Claude Code does not auto-load this directory; reference the rules from CLAUDE.md or another loaded context file. MCP servers are merged into project-root /.mcp.json (workspace) or ~/.claude.json (user/global) under the mcpServers key.

cursor.notes: Cursor reads project rules at .cursor/rules/<name>.mdc and subagents at .cursor/agents/<name>.md (https://cursor.com/docs/subagents). Skill content becomes a rule with the Cursor frontmatter contract; agents land at .cursor/agents/<name>.md. Cursor also reads from .claude/agents/, so installing for claude-code overlaps with this — that's fine, both paths get populated. Override per-asset via overrides.cursor.{globs, alwaysApply, model, readonly, is_background}. MCP servers land at .cursor/mcp.json (workspace) or ~/.cursor/mcp.json (global) under the mcpServers key.

antigravity.notes: Google Antigravity reads skills as directories containing SKILL.md. Workspace location is .agent/skills/; global at ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/. The assetPaths.skills value is empty so skills land at the target root. MCP servers are stored only globally at ~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json — Antigravity does not (as of mid-2026) support per-workspace MCP configs.

gemini-cli.notes: Gemini CLI's skills support is evolving. This config places skills at ~/.gemini/skills/ (global) or .gemini/skills/ (workspace). Verify against your installed Gemini CLI version — earlier versions only honour a GEMINI.md context file. MCP servers are merged into settings.json under the mcpServers key. Gemini-specific per-server fields you may want to set via overrides: httpUrl (HTTP-streaming transport, distinct from url which is SSE), cwd, timeout, trust, includeTools, excludeTools.

vscode-copilot.notes: Custom agents land at .github/agents/<name>.md per GitHub's docs (https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/agents/cloud-agent/about-custom-agents). Skill content becomes .github/instructions/<name>.instructions.md and commands become .github/prompts/<name>.prompt.md. Per-asset overrides via overrides.vscode-copilot.{applyTo,mode,tools,model,mcp-servers}. For Copilot to load the files, enable the workspace setting chat.promptFiles. MCP servers are merged into .vscode/mcp.json — note that VS Code uses the wrapper key 'servers' (not 'mcpServers'). User-scope MCP config exists but is managed via the 'MCP: Open User Configuration' command, so we don't write it directly.

copilot-cli.notes: Shares the .github/ tree with vscode-copilot — agents at .github/agents/<name>.md, instructions at .github/instructions/, prompts at .github/prompts/. Global ~/.copilot/ holds user-wide instructions. The legacy `gh copilot` extension does NOT consume these files; this config targets the newer agentic `copilot` CLI. MCP servers are written to ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json (global only); the CLI also discovers workspace-local mcp-config.json files but the GitHub docs don't standardize a per-project path.

kiro.notes: Steering files at .kiro/steering/<name>.md inject project guidance into the agent. Hooks land at .kiro/hooks/<name>.sh PLUS a sibling <name>.kiro.hook JSON describing the hook (name, description, command, enabled). Kiro discovers hooks via the JSON sidecar; the .sh alone is not enough. MCP servers are merged into .kiro/settings/mcp.json (workspace) or ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json (global). Kiro-specific per-server fields you may want to set via overrides: disabled, autoApprove, disabledTools.

kiro-cli.notes: Treated as a sibling of Kiro IDE — shares .kiro/steering/ at workspace scope and supports a ~/.kiro/ user-wide steering directory. If your Kiro CLI build uses different paths, override this config or pass --target. MCP servers share the same path layout as Kiro IDE.
